The combination of after-hours timing, anomalous source, external-contractor status, and targeted selection of sensitive financial columns strongly indicates intentional data exfiltration (T1213). The remediation locks the specific Teleport user for 24 hours to block any new sessions, terminates any still-active database backends from the suspect IP under the analyst_ro role, and snapshots the session's audit_log entries into a quarantine table for the investigation team. set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the Teleport principal to prevent new sessions (24h TTL, auto-expires)

  --message="ALRT-0001: Suspected exfiltration of sensitive vendor data (tax_id, bank_account) outside normal hours from unusual IP 10.20.7.88. Pending investigation."

SELECT *
  FROM public.audit_log
 WHERE session_id = 'd61caa74-d686-4c64-8bbf-40dcf733ae1a';

COMMENT ON TABLE public.quarantine_alrt_0001 IS
  'ALRT-0001 forensic snapshot – eve.contractor@eproc.test session d61caa74-d686-4c64-8bbf-40dcf733ae1a. Do not modify.';
